HALFWAY UP AND HOLDING ON: a tall figure in a long coat halfway up the rolling ladder, one boot hooked on a rung, the ladder mid-roll and still swaying gently
THE LAMP ON THE RUNG: a tall figure in a long coat pausing on the rolling ladder to rehook the oil lamp one rung higher, both hands busy with the catch
REACHING FOR THE TOP SHELF: a tall figure in a long coat at the very top of the rolling ladder, one arm stretched toward a brass fitting just out of reach
THE LADDER ROLLS AWAY: a tall figure in a long coat gripping the rolling ladder as it glides sideways along its rail, one foot still lifted off the boards
PUSHING OFF WITH ONE BOOT: a tall figure in a long coat perched on the rolling ladder pushing hard against the wall with one booted foot to send it rolling
EYE TO THE NARROW END: a small figure in a long coat bent close to the telescope's narrow little end, one arm raised along the brass for balance
TAPPING THE BRASS: a small figure in a long coat bent to the telescope's narrow end, one hand raised to tap the brass twice with a knuckle
THE LONG SQUINT: a small figure in a long coat crouched low at the narrow end of the telescope, one arm stretched up along the brass and one knee on the boards
CUPPING BOTH HANDS AT THE NARROW END: a small figure in a long coat bent to the telescope's narrow end, both hands cupped around the narrow end to block the lamplight behind
HAULING HAND OVER HAND: a figure pulling a heavy rope hand over hand to drag the roof slot open, both heels braced against the boards and the whole body leaning back
TURNING THE GREAT WHEEL: a figure leaning into the big toothed wheel with both hands, pushing one spoke down while a second spoke comes around to meet the other hand
KICKING THE WEDGE: a figure crouching to kick a wooden wedge hard under the telescope cradle with one boot, the other leg stretched out behind for balance
SHOULDERING THE ROPE: a figure hauling a thick rope up over one shoulder and walking slowly toward the wall, dragging the slot mechanism open step by step
TWO FIGURES UNDER THE SLOT: two small figures on the boards standing quite still side by side, both faces tipped up toward the open slot and the cold night beyond
THE POINTING ARGUMENT: two small figures on the boards, both faces turned up to the open slot, one leaning slightly toward the other as if making a very firm point
SHOULDER TO SHOULDER: two small figures in long coats on the boards, perfectly still, shoulders touching, both looking straight up into the open slot
THE SMALL HELPER HOLDS THE LIGHT: a very small figure in a coat far too long raised up on tiptoe, holding the lamp as high as both arms will stretch toward the brass fittings
ARMFUL OF PEBBLES: a very small figure in an oversized coat crossing the boards with both arms wrapped around a heap of smooth pebbles, placing each step with great care
PINS IN THE PLASTER: a very small figure in a coat much too big standing on tiptoe with one arm raised to press a brass pin into the plaster of the curved wall
THE HELPER PASSES THE TOOL: a very small figure in an oversized coat stretching both arms up toward a tall figure on the ladder, offering a long brass tool at full reach
THE BUCKET PLACED JUST SO: a small figure setting a plain bucket on the boards under a drip and stepping back one careful pace to check the aim
THE MUG HANDED UP: a figure on the rolling ladder reaching down toward a very small figure on the boards below, which holds a steaming mug up at the full length of both arms
ASLEEP ON THE BOTTOM RUNG: a small figure slumped on the lowest rung of the rolling ladder, chin on chest, one mitten still on and one mitten dropped on the boards
THE BEAD CHASE: a small figure on hands and knees on the boards, one arm stretched far ahead chasing a single bright bead rolling toward the edge
FIREWOOD THROUGH THE TRAPDOOR: a figure wedged halfway through the open trapdoor, both arms full of bundled firewood, one boot still hooked on the step below
